projects.title: Diorama Journey
projects.subject: A miniature cream gateway with a terracotta cap, sage island and model trees, stone path and amber lantern

description.en: Miniature 3D storytelling with narration, chapter clips and slides
description.zh: 通过微缩 3D 场景讲故事，生成配音、分章视频与幻灯片

purpose.en: Turn source material into an original narrated miniature 3D journey. A recurring element connects the chapters; the same timeline produces a full film, chapter MP4 clips, subtitles and PPTX/PDF/ODP slides with speaker notes. Install the skill to create an independent project from its starter.
purpose.zh: 把原始材料转成原创的配音微缩 3D 旅程，以一个贯穿元素连接各个章节。同一条时间线导出完整影片、分章 MP4、字幕，以及带演讲备注的 PPTX/PDF/ODP 幻灯片。安装技能后，可从 starter 创建独立项目。

design.motif: Shallow arch construction arcs, paired alignment ticks, five small chapter stations connected by a gently turning route, and faint short measurement strokes, pressed into continuous model-making board.

description.en: Pressed gateway arcs, alignment ticks and a five-stop chapter route on model-making board.
description.zh: 模型工作纸上压印拱门弧线、定位刻度与五站章节路线。

design.rationale: The original example carries one amber lantern through a gateway, lookout, workshop, bridge and garden. Model-making construction marks connect the physical miniature scenes with the shared chapter timeline. This is a working surface for a 3D storytelling tool, not a botanical habitat or a literal UI diagram.
